title: Trance Safely
description:
Hello sweeteas! This is a hypnosis safety file meant to be listened to before or after an intense session, or whenever you wish to. It’s short and to the point, but drops you deep and installs very basic safeties in your mind. Try to have a list of your hard limits in mind when starting the file, so that they’re fresh in your thoughts.
The purpose of this session is simple: to help keep you safe from suggestions which go against your nature and break the limits of behavioral modifications that you’ve set for yourself. If there are limits that you wish hypnosis wouldn’t tread upon, listen and feel safe in the knowledge that everything that happens will only happen if you allow it. Feel safe in the surety that your subconscious mind will protect your core and your base critical thoughts.
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
RAW: usually just a plain recording, with no effects whatsoever, except for when binaurals are specified.
SFX: with sound effects, like echoes, panning, 3D, environmental effects, and all sorts of fun stuff.
Some files have many versions you can chooses from, while others are more sparse.
There is but one RAW version of this file.
author: Miss Lilith
